summary: The paper and all six publisher supplements were recovered. Every one of the 13,266 gene rows in Table S2 repeats six fitted statistics from a distinct polyadenylation site in Table S1, and none of those sites carries the same gene label. An independent worksheet check confirmed the finding. The original gene-level effects and significance calls therefore remain unresolved. [Table S2](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S0031938418300349-mmc3.xlsx) · [Table S1](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S0031938418300349-mmc2.xlsx)
openIssues: Can the authors provide the original gene-ID-keyed HFD-versus-chow fit, including log2 fold changes, raw P and adjusted P, and explain how the S1 site statistics came to appear in S2?
Which animals or pools contributed to each fitted library, and was the control technical replicate included?
